_about: Known camera makers / models: factory logins, how PTZ is driven and whether the PTZ position can be read. The camera tool (discover.py) tries the logins of the matching entry first (at most max_login_tries in all, cameras lock after a few wrong passwords), then the others. Add a new model here when it arrives. Your plant's own passwords go into default_logins.json (not in git). Matching: maker_match / model_match are parts of the maker / model text the camera reports over ONVIF (lower case).

entries.name: YM800S5 PTZ (generic, 5x zoom)
entries.note: Shows P/T/Z on its OSD but reports 0,0,0 over ONVIF GetStatus: position not readable (events get P00T00Z00).

entries.name: Dahua (and OEM: Amcrest, Lorex, 'General')
entries.note: Newer firmware has no factory password (set at first start).

entries.name: Hikvision (and OEM: HiLook, Annke)
entries.note: Firmware since 2016 must be activated with a new password first.

entries.name: NVT / APCam (e.g. JA-A1A)
entries.note: ONVIF answers without a login; the login is checked on the video. Moves but reports no position.
